title: Franka Panda × 3 · contracted contacts

limitations: assumed network predictions; no learned model inference
IK-prescribed joint path with optimized forces/torques; not full CITO
assumed synthetic gripper capability; no hardware calibration
force-only planning does not certify measured finite-gripper moments
pressure-limited point seal, not cup/fluid FEM
preparation is scripted; final pose is held

description: Three real 7-DoF Panda URDF arms and upstream visual/collision meshes. IK prescribes a fixed-orientation contact path; IPOPT optimizes inertial reaction allocation and derived joint torques. Clarabel checks frozen keyframe wrench margins. MuJoCo integrates a free panel with sphere, native Panda fingers and pressure-limited suction. No trained network inference, full CITO or continuous collision certificate.
